transcript.content: Which high-risk user requirements are not currently verified? For each one, give the requirement ID and the reason.

content.text: I'll start by checking the high-risk requirements and how they link to the risk assessments.

input.query: SELECT l.src_id AS fra, l.tgt_id AS urs, r.risk_class, r.sev, r.ri_id, s.req_category, s.sys_id, s.item_text FROM pd.trace_link l JOIN pd.val_risk_item r ON r.ri_id=l.src_id JOIN pd.val_spec_item s ON s.item_id=l.tgt_id WHERE l.link_type='ASSESSES' ORDER BY 1
SELECT link_type, src_type, tgt_type, count(*) FROM pd.trace_link GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT item_id, spec_level, sys_id, req_category, item_text, approved_dt FROM pd.val_spec_item WHERE spec_level='URS' ORDER BY 1

content.text: There are 26 HIGH-risk URSs. Next I'll pull the spec hierarchy, test cases, and change-control links.

input.query: SELECT l.link_id, l.src_type, l.src_id, l.link_type, l.tgt_type, l.tgt_id, s.spec_level AS src_lvl, t.spec_level AS tgt_lvl FROM pd.trace_link l LEFT JOIN pd.val_spec_item s ON s.item_id=l.src_id LEFT JOIN pd.val_spec_item t ON t.item_id=l.tgt_id WHERE l.link_type IN ('TRACE','VERIFIES','IMPACTS') ORDER BY l.link_type, l.src_id
SELECT item_id, spec_level, sys_id, req_category, left(item_text,110) t, approved_dt FROM pd.val_spec_item WHERE spec_level<>'URS' ORDER BY 1
SELECT tc.tc_id, tc.protocol_id, tc.method, tc.title, p.ptype, p.status FROM pd.val_test_case tc LEFT JOIN pd.val_protocol p ON p.protocol_id=tc.protocol_id ORDER BY 1
SELECT cc_no, open_dt, title, change_class, status, impl_dt, left(impact_assessment,300) ia FROM pd.qms_change_control ORDER BY 1
SELECT equip_id, equip_type, sys_id, cal_due_dt FROM pd.equipment ORDER BY 1; SELECT * FROM pd.val_system ORDER BY 1;
